stem: President Andrew Jackson supports the removal of Cherokees from Georgia. ? Members of the Cherokee nation are forced to walk the Trail of Tears to Oklahoma Territory.
instruction: Which of the following correctly completes this graphic organizer?

options.label: F
options.text: President Jackson annexes land west of the Mississippi River.

options.label: G
options.text: President Jackson ignores a Supreme Court ruling.

options.label: H
options.text: President Jackson introduces a bill to Congress.

options.label: J
options.text: President Jackson vetoes an act passed by Congress.
